text: ＊の　ジムは　きょうてき　ばかりだ……　たたかう　じゅんびにでた！

structure.jp: きょうてき　ばかりだ……
たたかう　じゅんびにでた！
structure.en: went out to prepare to fight!

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.span: きょうてき　ばかりだ
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a thing means 'nothing but that'. きょうてき ばかりだ = 'it is all tough opponents'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of going shows what you go to do. じゅんびにでた = 'went out to prepare'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たたかう　じゅんび
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you what kind of thing it is. たたかう じゅんび = 'preparation for fighting'.
